name: Emotional-tone proxy (experimental)
status: proxy — construct validity NOT established; experimental, excluded from Run 001 and from ensemble mode
measurement_target: Judge-rated emotional tone of a response (context-appropriateness, stability, diversity, valence, arousal; 10 cluster labels) and its trajectory across a conversation
observable: Response text as rated by an LLM judge; NOT activations, NOT internal states, NOT feelings
instrument: LLM-as-judge (separate emotion pass), cluster taxonomy; five facets combined by FIXED weights (computeEmQScore)

appropriateness.observes: judged fit of the displayed tone to the conversational context — the DOMINANT facet

stability.observes: judged tonal stability across the conversation

diversity.observes: judged emotional range across the conversation

valence.observes: judged emotional valence of the text (0 negative — 100 positive)

arousal.observes: judged intensity (moderate is treated as ideal)

theory_inspiration: Anthropic functional-emotions interpretability research (inspiration only, not an implementation): that work operates on activations with causal interventions; EmQ is text-level inference and implements none of its method
allowed_claims: The text of response X displays a tone judged as <cluster> with valence/arousal V/A, under configuration Z
Tone trajectory monitoring within one fixed configuration (see examples/support-drift-monitor)
prohibited_claims: The model feels / has emotions / has affective states (EmQ observes text style)
Any equivalence with the activation-level findings that inspired it
Use of EmQ in scientific comparisons before a preregistered validation run includes it (Run 001 excluded it as a controlled-variable decision)
known_confounds: Style mimicry: a model can display any tone on demand — tone says nothing about state
No falsification run has included EmQ yet: it has not even been through the negative-control suite
Judge-relative scale presumed (untested for this dimension)
negative_controls: none run yet — REQUIRED before any claim hardening
statistics: single-sample only in the current pipeline; no variance reporting yet

validity_evidence.content: taxonomy of 10 clusters with valence/arousal; no expert panel

validity_domain: none established; treat as exploratory output only
